theorems.name: Submission.dtc_blowUp_scaling
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U A : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (x : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam), IsOpen U → 0 < n → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), (blowUp T x lam hlam.ne').massOn (dilation x lam '' W) = ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ n) * T.massOn W) ∧ (∀ R : IMRep U n, R.Represents T → ∃ R' : IMRep (dilation x lam '' U) n, R'.Represents (blowUp T x lam hlam.ne') ∧ ∀ s : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet s → R'.measure s = ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ n) * R.measure (dilation x lam ⁻¹' s)) ∧ (IsMinimizingIn T A → IsMinimizingIn (blowUp T x lam hlam.ne') (dilation x lam '' A))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
